cases.case_label: ~3-kb IDS deletion with 157-bp AluS-containing insert (exon 8 skipping)
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~3-kb deletion of IDS sequence accompanied by a 157-bp insert partly matching an AluS; the authors propose Alu retrotransposition plus Alu-mediated deletion, and the rearrangement causes skipping of exon 8 in cDNA. Insertion origin is only partly resolved (only 83 bp recognized as Alu).
cases.quote: both an Alu retrotransposition and an Alu-mediated deletion underlie the disease-producing rearrangement
